request.description:
Rule 7/A4. statusmodel/cost.go:79-93 emits the decisions line metered with USD 0 whenever any decision record exists, even with no usage block, and nothing ever sets jev.Usage.CostUSD, so every local run with a decision shows 'decisions $0.00'. Cloud: runs.cost_usd is NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 and cloudStatusDoc (status.ts:481-492) / status_model.go:647 turn any number into a metered 'AI Gateway logs' line, so a run before its first cost sync or with telemetry 'unavailable: …' (cost_source, unread on the status path) shows 'Workers AI $0.00'. Fix: emit the decisions line metered only when a record carries a measured cost, and make the cloud line unmetered unless cost_source is 'gateway'; teach P3's generator a metered-zero/no-usage decision and an unsynced cloud record.
evidence: internal/statusmodel/cost.go:79-93; internal/jev/jev.go:185; cloudflare/migrations/0002_runs.sql:16; cloudflare/src/status.ts:481-492; internal/cli/status_model.go:647

ticfac run epic-hn6 created this tick by absorbing the finding 9a2119c4bfd29f34c98468360ed7f59a901a9ab023aea9a2bedad710c1c5a339 (reported by run-epic-hn6/tick-v16/attempt-1): the finding was judged against the epic's definition of done and gates done item A4. The decision record — item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence — is .ticfac/runs/epic-hn6/absorptions/9a2119c4bfd29f34c98468360ed7f59a901a9ab023aea9a2bedad710c1c5a339.json on the run branch.
